notes.title: English version of Lump of Sugar’s famous serial game 《Tayutama》is officially coming to STEAM!
notes.notes:
In order to respond to English GALGAME/Visual Novel players’ expectations, HIKARI FIELD and Lump of Sugar are now cooperating to publish the English version of the well-known serial works《Tayutama》. The first release《Smart Elves 2 -you’re the only one-》 is coming soon in the summer of 2017. Then others in the series will come later.

English website of 《Smart Elves 2 -you’re the only one-》 is already open, please visit:
http://www.hikarifield.com/tayutama2_en/

You can follow us on STEAM to get more information, and also welcome to our Twitter: @hikari_field.

notes.title: We now officially announce that 『tayutama 2-you’re the only one-』Chinese version join the Steam Trading Cards! You can Collect Cards, Craft Badges and Get Rewards!
notes.notes:
Steam Trading Cards are collectible cards you get by playing games on Steam. Collect a set of cards to earn items that help you customize your profile and show off your gameplay. A full set of cards can be crafted into a game badge that can be prominently displayed on the profile and the mini profile. During badge crafting users receive random rewards from a set of game related items including emoticons, profile backgrounds, and coupons.

We are ready now, and YOU?
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27021693/7282501c8349dd017d48263cf52fc83a3d8438b6.jpg
